code: import{useCallback,useEffect,useMemo}from"react";import{useDispatch,useSelector}from"react-redux";import{useForm}from"react-hook-form";import{useState}from"react";import{getAddressStates,createAddressState,updateAddressState}from"modules/administration/slices/addressStateSlice";import{showSuccessToast,showErrorToast}from"common/ToastMessage";import CommonMessage from"common/CommonMessage";const useStateForm=()=>{const dispatch=useDispatch();const[createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen]=useState(false);const[editValues,setEditValues]=useState([]);const{control,reset,handleSubmit}=useForm({});const{addressStates,isLoading,isError}=useSelector(state=>state.addressStates);useEffect(()=>{dispatch(getAddressStates());},[dispatch]);useEffect(()=>{reset({...editValues});},[reset,editValues]);const onSubmit=useCallback(async(body,editFlag)=>{try{if(editFlag){await dispatch(updateAddressState({id:editValues===null||editValues===void 0?void 0:editValues.uuid,newData:body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00003.replace("%s","Address State"));}else{await dispatch(createAddressState({...body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00001.replace("%s","Address State"));}reset();setEditValues("");setCreateModalOpen(false);await dispatch(getAddressStates());}catch(error){console.error("Error",error);}},[dispatch,reset,editValues]);return useMemo(()=>({control,onSubmit,handleSubmit,addressStates,createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen:value=>setCreateModalOpen(value),setEditValues:value=>setEditValues(value),editValues,isLoading,isError}),[control,onSubmit,handleSubmit,addressStates,createModalOpen,editValues,isError,isLoading]);};export default useStateForm;
